data.name: Azmi
data.long_meaning: The name Azmi is derived from the Arabic root 'Azamah' which means 'to be steadfast, to be strong, to be trustworthy'. This name is often given to babies to signify their strength and stability, and to encourage them to be steadfast in their faith and actions.
